nodes.norm_label: /clubs/[id] shows only non-empty fields, utc-formatted verified_at, booking/site links open with noopener noreferrer (task 2.8)
nodes.rationale: Empty fields render as nothing rather than a dash or guessed value, consistent with the 'unknown' philosophy of 2.11; noreferrer avoids leaking the referring page to the club's site.

nodes.label: Map performs a one-time fitBounds over all markers once the container has a non-zero size, maxZoom 15 (task 2.12)
nodes.norm_label: map performs a one-time fitbounds over all markers once the container has a non-zero size, maxzoom 15 (task 2.12)
nodes.rationale: On mobile the map mounts hidden (0x0) so fitBounds must wait for the resize signal that already drives invalidateSize(); doing it only once avoids fighting a user who has since panned/zoomed.

nodes.norm_label: /offers/[id] is a public page; getofferdetails() returns a different view per viewer role (guest/player/author); action buttons are ui hints only, re-validated by the server action (task 3.13)
nodes.rationale: Buttons showing only valid actions is a convenience, not a security boundary — every server action re-checks its own rules (3.11/3.12) independently.

nodes.label: requestToJoin: joinRefusal() pure-function rules, createMany with skipDuplicates for idempotent double-click protection, generic ok/refusal response with no contact info (task 3.11)
nodes.norm_label: requesttojoin: joinrefusal() pure-function rules, createmany with skipduplicates for idempotent double-click protection, generic ok/refusal response with no contact info (task 3.11)
nodes.rationale: skipDuplicates turns a concurrent duplicate request into a Postgres ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, avoiding a unique-constraint error race; responses never leak contact info since the private thread is the only communication channel.

nodes.label: Account deletion: profile/photo/email/birthdate erased, message text replaced with '[deleted]', open offers cancelled, confirmed matches kept with 'Deleted player'
nodes.norm_label: account deletion: profile/photo/email/birthdate erased, message text replaced with '[deleted]', open offers cancelled, confirmed matches kept with 'deleted player'
nodes.rationale: Consistent with the 2026-09-28 Restrict-on-match-results decision — opponents' ELO history must not depend on whether someone later deleted their account.

nodes.label: Auto-block: 3 reports from different users within 30 days blocks a player from creating offers/joins/messages pending admin review
nodes.norm_label: auto-block: 3 reports from different users within 30 days blocks a player from creating offers/joins/messages pending admin review
nodes.rationale: Requiring different reporters guards against one person gaming the auto-block; a 30-day window keeps old reports from accumulating indefinitely.

nodes.label: Offer gets courtStatus: BOOKED / WILL_BOOK (default) / ANY
nodes.norm_label: offer gets courtstatus: booked / will_book (default) / any
nodes.rationale: Authors don't always book ahead — many arrange the game first and book afterward, matching the WILL_BOOK default to the common case.

nodes.label: Result confirmation: opponent confirms; auto-confirm after 72h with a 24h reminder; disputed results don't affect ELO until admin resolves
nodes.norm_label: result confirmation: opponent confirms; auto-confirm after 72h with a 24h reminder; disputed results don't affect elo until admin resolves
nodes.rationale: Without auto-confirm, one disappearing player would permanently block ELO updates; 72h gives enough time to respond without long delay.
